representation_plans.learner_operation: Move along the spectrum while tracking the opposite wavelength direction and the shared frequency and photon-energy direction.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: An ordered text scale lists radio, microwave, infrared, visible red-to-violet, ultraviolet, X-ray, and gamma regions with wavelength decreasing as frequency and photon energy increase.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Count path-derived phase and any stated reflection reversal before deciding whether fields reinforce or cancel.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A path table lists each ray length, phase change in wavelength units, reflection reversal, and relative arrival phase without identifying the requested outcome.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Compare wavelength with aperture or spacing, then track the angle required for a stated diffraction order.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text table lists aperture or lattice spacing, wavelength, diffraction order, and observed angular width or peak direction without marking the answer.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Orient the right hand from electric-field direction toward magnetic-field direction to identify propagation, then inspect whether the electric-field tip follows a line or circle.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: An axis-labeled text description gives signed x, y, and z directions for electric field, magnetic field, propagation, and polarizer axis, plus the time trace of the electric-field tip.
